PARAM:N_i.meaning: maximum interception count for target i

PARAM:theta_m.meaning: missile load / maximum missile capacity of missile vehicle m

PARAM:c_m.meaning: operational cost of missile vehicle m per assigned interception

PARAM:p_i_k.meaning: interception probability of kth interception of target i, derived from selected missile/radar/time geometry

PARAM:T_start_i_k.meaning: radar start tracking time for kth interception of target i

PARAM:T_launch_i_k.meaning: missile launch time for kth interception of target i

PARAM:T_end_i_k.meaning: ending / kill-assessment time of kth interception of target i

PARAM:Delta_t_1.meaning: required radar tracking time before launch or engagement end

PARAM:Delta_t_2.meaning: minimum interval between consecutive interceptions of the same target

PARAM:Delta_t_3.meaning: maximum interval between consecutive interceptions of the same target

PARAM:phi_ir_t.meaning: 1 if target i is detectable by radar r at time t

PARAM:C_r_max.meaning: maximum channel capacity of radar r

PARAM:c_need.meaning: channel requirement for tracking one target

PARAM:psi_im_t.meaning: 1 if target i is within missile vehicle m's engagement condition at time t

PARAM:ACC_ir_t.meaning: radar accuracy factor derived from target-radar distance and radar range at time t

VAR:x_i_m_k.meaning: 1 if missile vehicle m performs the kth interception of target i

VAR:y_i_r_k.meaning: 1 if radar r tracks target i for its kth interception

VAR:t_i_k.meaning: interception time selected for kth interception of target i

DERIVED:V(X).meaning: expected interception value of the assignment scheme

OBJ:OBJ1.meaning: under unsaturated attacks choose high-value cost-effective schemes; under saturated attacks prioritize interception value

CON:C1.meaning: at most one missile vehicle is assigned for the kth interception of target i

CON:C2.meaning: at most one radar tracks the kth interception of target i

CON:C3.meaning: a planned interception must have both missile vehicle and radar assignment

CON:C5.meaning: time interval between consecutive interceptions of the same target

CON:C8.meaning: radar channel occupancy induced by assignment

CON:C10.meaning: interception probability feasibility and geometry logic

SEMANTIC:unsupported_static_radar_target.meaning: static radar-target times missile-target product without interception time

SEMANTIC:unsupported_multiobjective_vect.meaning: multiobjective vector unless public scenario explicitly asks for a downstream variant

SEMANTIC:unsupported_dynamic_stage_recur.meaning: dynamic stage recurrence not present in the ADRAP model

SEMANTIC:unsupported_omitting_radar_chan.meaning: omitting radar channel capacity or missile load constraints

SEMANTIC:unsupported_planted_interceptio.meaning: planted interception scheme or QGLEA local-search trace in public input

algorithm_boundary: Q-learning-guided global-local evolutionary algorithm, adaptive strategy selection and knowledge-guided search are solution mechanisms, not optimization model constraints
